function: Learns STAR-RIS phase shifts and amplitude coefficients jointly with offloading ratio and transmission time, minimizing long-term system energy (p. 1, p. 7).
system: Single-antenna BS and 4 UEs, energy-splitting STAR-RIS with 16 elements, NOMA, Rician links, 1 MHz bandwidth; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 9).
method: Decomposition-based multi-agent TD3 actor-critic (four agents, 16-neuron hidden layers), reinforcement learning by interaction; power and CPU frequency in closed form (p. 7, p. 9).
data_channel: Custom simulated Rician channels (factor 10, LoS plus CN(0,1) NLoS), path-loss exponents 3.5, 2, 2; trained on this simulator, no dataset or measurement (p. 3, p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained 10,000 episodes of 100 slots per setting; slot length, UEs, RIS elements, data size varied; no separate test in unseen conditions (p. 9, p. 10, p. 11).
baselines: Learned: centralized TD3 (CTD3), decomposition-based multi-agent DDPG (DB-MADDPG). RIS designs: time-switching STAR-RIS, conventional RIS, STAR-RIS with random phases and amplitudes (SRRAP) (p. 10, p. 11).
metrics: Mean reward per episode, system energy consumption in joules, Jain's fairness index of UE energy (p. 10, p. 11, p. 12).
complexity: Order of complexity: training O(S T Gamma (sum(2Gi+2Ci)+3K)), execution O(sum Gi+3K), from network layer sizes; no runtime or FLOPs reported (p. 9).
openness: none; no code or data link, only simulation parameters in Table I (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 3: "denotes the Rician factor" - custom Rician LoS/NLoS channel with path-loss exponents 3.5, 2, 2 (Table I, p. 9); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 8: "retraining the agents is necessary" - no trained model is tested in unseen conditions; Fig. 5 (p. 10) shows training curves per setting, and network sizes depend on K and N (p. 9).
q3_support: p. 10: "In the CTD3 algorithm, a single agent is responsible for" - the learned comparators CTD3 and DB-MADDPG are variants of the proposed DB-MATD3 (centralized; DDPG instead of TD3), compared on mean reward curves; no earlier published learned method.
q4_support: p. 9: "leading to a total complexity of" - gives O(S T Gamma (sum(2Gi+2Ci)+3K)) for training and O(sum Gi+3K) for execution; no runtime.
q5_support: p. 9: "In the simulation, the BS is located at coordinate" - self-built simulator with parameters in Table I; no code or data link, public dataset or availability statement in the paper.
notes: Included under the joint-decision rule of above_phy, read as general: agents learn RIS phase shifts and amplitudes (area 3, p. 7) together with offloading ratio and time (above PHY); if that rule is limited to aerial links, the reason would be above_phy. Main metric is system energy. Table I (p. 9) was read from the page image. q3 is a judgement call: CTD3 and DB-MADDPG could be read as standard learned baselines, but Sec. V-B (p. 10) is titled convergence comparison and Fig. 6 (p. 11) compares energy only against RIS designs. Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
